jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (Healthcare)
jobs.description:
Senior Product Manager

Remote (periodic travel to Arizona) · Reports to CTO
*YOU MUST LIVE IN THE UNITED STATES*

*340B IS A MUST*

We're hiring a Senior Product Manager to own product for our 340B compliance platform — working closely with engineering and operations to turn deep regulatory complexity into a seamless, reliable product our customers can actually depend on.
You'll sit at the center of the business: translating what operations and compliance need into clear direction for engineering, and making sure what ships actually works the way it's supposed to for the physician practices we serve. The technical architecture and direction are owned by engineering — your job is to make sure what gets built solves the real problem, not to dictate how it's built.
This is an autonomous, senior role — you're making real product calls, not gathering requirements and passing them along.
What you'll do:

Own product strategy and roadmap for our 340B compliance platform, end to end
Work closely with engineering and operations to translate complex 340B requirements into product decisions that actually hold up in practice
Partner directly with our Data Acquisition Engineer to confirm that synthesized EMR data meets real operational and compliance requirements
Validate that what ships actually meets the operational requirement — using AI tooling (Cursor, ChatGPT, Claude, and other current tools) to reason through test scenarios and confirm system behavior (roughly 15% of the role)
Identify gaps between what the system does and what compliance and operations actually require, before they become customer-facing problems

What you bring:

Senior product management experience — you've owned a product end to end and made real calls, not just gathered requirements
Deep, credible 340B expertise — hands-on experience at a covered entity, contract pharmacy, or 340B consulting environment. You need to know the domain cold to do this job well.
Comfortable operating autonomously, while deferring to engineering on technical architecture and implementation decisions
Product-first instinct on validation — you think in terms of "does this meet the requirement," not deep code-level QA
Fluent working with AI tools (Cursor, ChatGPT, Claude, or whatever's current) as part of how you reason through and validate product decisions

Details:

Remote, periodic travel to Arizona — must live near a major US airport
US Citizens or Green Card holders only — no C2C, no consultants
Compensation based on experience, senior-level

Director

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Community Support Experience
jobs.description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join

Airbnb is a vision and mission driven company. Our Product Managers (PMs) embody this culture and mindset. Platform Product Managers here imagine the ideal end state for our community (guests and hosts) first, work backwards from it, and deliver the vision in a scalable way. They champion a winning strategy and leverage metrics to ensure we are making progress against it. They partner with talented cross-functional team members (across product marketing, engineering, design, analytics, etc.) and lead teams to execute upon a shared vision. We are looking for leaders who want to join us in this journey to accomplish our mission of creating belonging everywhere.

The Difference You Will Make

A support journey starts from the moment a guest or a host reaches out for help and ends when his/her challenge is resolved. PMs at Community Experience Platform lead cross team collaborations and deliver best-of-the-class support experience and platform capabilities. Keen eyes on great user experience, strong collaboration and influence skills are must-haves to thrive as a PM in Community Experience Platform. The Senior Platform Product Manager, Community Experience Platform will be responsible for major experience platforms that power Airbnb’s support experiences. The successful candidate will lead high profile projects and work collaboratively across multiple cross functional teams across the company

A Typical Day

Understand the competitive landscape. Challenge the status quo. Influence design and product marketing team and inspire people towards a unified outcome.
Define success with clearly measurable objectives and key results.
Define a winning product strategy and create a sound roadmap.
Align the vision, OKR, strategy and roadmap with senior leaders and stakeholders across the company.
Prioritize work based on inputs from many stakeholders, while being flexible to iterate/change.
Maintain product backlog and the product roadmap.
Partner with senior tech leads and execute the vision with cross function leaders from multiple teams.
Present product roadmap and status to the leadership on an ongoing basis.

Your Expertise

5+ years of product management, or product design experience ( at least 5 out of the 8 years in a product management role).
Exceptional communication skills. Being able to adapt communication style for different types of audiences.
Ability to appreciate and articulate great user experience.
Ability to quickly absorb technical concepts and communicate them to a non-technical audience.
Outcome-oriented. Articulates the desired outcome and works collaboratively to create a path to achieve it.
Experience working with partners beyond just one’s immediate cross functional team in a product management or business role.
Radical thinking paired with strong execution. Can envision a world different from the status quo with the ability to articulate a clear path to get there.

Your Location:

This position is US - Remote Eligible. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. While the position is Remote Eligible, you must live in a state where Airbnb, Inc. has a registered entity. Click here for the up-to-date list of excluded states. This list is continuously evolving, so please check back with us if the state you live in is on the exclusion list If your position is employed by another Airbnb entity, your recruiter will inform you what states you are eligible to work from.

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

We strive to also provide a disability inclusive application and interview process. If you are a candidate with a disability and require reasonable accommodation in order to submit an application, please contact us at: reasonableaccommodations@airbnb.com. Please include your full name, the role you’re applying for and the accommodation necessary to assist you with the recruiting process.

We ask that you only reach out to us if you are a candidate whose disability prevents you from being able to complete our online application.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Airbnb values diversity & belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Airbnb are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, gender, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic.

How We'll Take Care Of You

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.

Pay Range

$179,000—$207,000 USD

Reasonable Accommodations:
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

A Note on Recruiting Scams:
Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb.com or @ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing. We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.
